title: codeanalyzer-java v1 analysis output
description: Generated from the Lombok @Data entity classes of codeanalyzer-java v2.4.1. The repo is on its 2.x version line; the schema it emits is still v1 — the v2 schema migration has not begun. Property names are the Gson LOWER_CASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES rendering of the Java field names, which CodeAnalyzer configures; each property keeps its Java field under x-java.

symbol_table.description: Per-compilation-unit analysis, keyed by absolute source file path.

call_graph.description: Call graph / system dependency graph edges. Present only at analysis level >= 2.

version.description: Analyzer version string, or "unknown" / "error retrieving version" when it could not be resolved.

context.description: The Context. -- GETTER -- Gets context. @return the context

weight.description: The Weight. -- GETTER -- Gets weight. @return the weight

context.description: The Context. -- GETTER -- Gets context. @return the context

weight.description: The Weight. -- GETTER -- Gets weight. @return the weight

method_name.description: Name of the method being called

comment.description: Comment associated with the call site

receiver_expr.description: Expression representing the receiver of the method call

argument_types.description: List of argument types for the method call

argument_expr.description: List of argument expressions for the method call

return_type.description: Return type of the called method

callee_signature.description: Full signature of the callee method

is_public.description: Flag indicating if the method has public access

is_protected.description: Flag indicating if the method has protected access

is_private.description: Flag indicating if the method has private access

is_unspecified.description: Flag indicating if the method has unspecified access

is_static_call.description: Flag indicating if this is a static method call

is_constructor_call.description: Flag indicating if this is a constructor call

crud_operation.description: CRUD operation associated with this call site, if any

crud_query.description: CRUD query associated with this call site, if any

start_line.description: Starting line number of the call site in the source file

start_column.description: Starting column number of the call site in the source file

end_line.description: Ending line number of the call site in the source file

end_column.description: Ending column number of the call site in the source file

file_path.description: The file path where the callable entity is defined.

signature.description: The signature of the callable entity.

comments.description: A list of comments associated with the callable entity.

annotations.description: A list of annotations applied to the callable entity.

modifiers.description: A list of modifiers applied to the callable entity (e.g., public, private).

thrown_exceptions.description: A list of exceptions thrown by the callable entity.

declaration.description: The declaration of the callable entity.

parameters.description: A list of parameters for the callable entity.

code.description: The code of the callable entity.

start_line.description: The starting line number of the callable entity in the source file.

end_line.description: The ending line number of the callable entity in the source file.

code_start_line.description: The starting line number of the callable code in the source file.

return_type.description: The return type of the callable entity.

is_implicit.description: Indicates whether the callable entity is implicit.

is_constructor.description: Indicates whether the callable entity is a constructor.

referenced_types.description: A list of types referenced by the callable entity.

accessed_fields.description: A list of fields accessed by the callable entity.

call_sites.description: A list of call sites within the callable entity.

variable_declarations.description: A list of variable declarations within the callable entity.

crud_operations.description: A list of CRUD operations associated with the callable entity.

crud_queries.description: A list of CRUD queries associated with the callable entity.

cyclomatic_complexity.description: The cyclomatic complexity of the callable entity.

is_entrypoint.description: Indicates whether the callable entity is an entry point.

content.description: The textual content of the comment.

start_line.description:
The starting line number of the comment in the source file.

Defaults to {@code -1} if the position is unknown.

end_line.description:
The ending line number of the comment in the source file.

Defaults to {@code -1} if the position is unknown.

start_column.description:
The starting column number of the comment in the source file.

Defaults to {@code -1} if the position is unknown.

end_column.description:
The ending column number of the comment in the source file.

Defaults to {@code -1} if the position is unknown.

is_javadoc.description:
Indicates whether the comment is a Javadoc comment.

Javadoc comments are special block comments used for generating documentation and typically start with {@code }.

Dependency.description: One call-graph / SDG edge. Emitted only at analysis level >= 2. SDG edges additionally carry source_kind and destination_kind.

type.description: The type of the parameter (e.g., int, String).

annotations.description: A list of annotations applied to the parameter.

modifiers.description: A list of modifiers applied to the parameter (e.g., final, static).

start_line.description: The starting line number of the parameter in the source file.

end_line.description: The ending line number of the parameter in the source file.

start_column.description: The starting column number of the parameter in the source file.

end_column.description: The ending column number of the parameter in the source file.
